originality.rationale: The specific interval family and sigma-finite existence/comparable shell masses are credited to Inoue–Toyokawa (2022, 2023). The final statement instead combines conditional independence of returned positions for all reset parameters, an all-law renewal generating function, equality (not just comparison) of every stationary shell mass, and a closed generating function for observable stationary correlations. These exact formulations are not stated in the examined primary model papers; the independent return-coordinate argument provides a separate mathematical step. No searched closely related record implies this full conjunction, though equivalent unindexed or inaccessible general inducing results remain possible.
